segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the ampoule as lightweight and non-greasy, with one suggesting it can double as a light moisturizer in hot climates.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report strong hydration and relief from flakiness, sometimes needing to layer it with a moisturizer for full effect.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it balances their skin without feeling too heavy or oily and evens out dry patches.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, stinging, or burning, describing it as gentle, soothing, and calming for redness, though one sensitive-dry reviewer felt it did not do much beyond hydration.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin report a fresher, more even, glowing appearance and softened fine lines with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report smoother, softer, more even-toned skin and softened fine lines with regular use; one reviewer credits the wider 1025 line for a visibly younger look.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong, lasting hydration and a plumped, less dehydrated look, with several noting the gel-to-water texture absorbs well; one reviewer with dry sensitive skin felt it showed no real results despite no irritation.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness concerns report visible calming and reduced intensity of redness over time, with no reports of redness worsening.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers mention the ceramide and panthenol content helping maintain barrier strength and soothe irritation, including easing a mild case of dermatitis in one case.
concerns.spots: One combination-skin reviewer reports the product helped even out dry patches and uneven areas, though this concern is mentioned by very few reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several acne-prone or blemish-prone reviewers note no new breakouts, but one reviewer says it worsened acne and textured skin, and another woke up with small pimples after first use.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers say the product feels light and non-oily even for oily skin, but one reviewer with normal/combination skin found it stayed sticky and tacky and made her skin look oily after a few minutes.

aspects.libelle: Bottle empties quickly for the price

extraits.texte: I was hoping this would calm my acne and even out my skintone, but it did the exact opposite of that. Made my acne worse and made my skin look very textured. I knew my skin would have that reaction period for the first few days, but it still looked awful when i was over half way thriugh the bottle. Never buying again.

Bought this and expected an amazing product but immediately noticed the poor ampoule packaging/dropper. This feels cheap and did not show reak results on my dry sensitive skin. It didnt cause a flare up or acne but it didnt do anything. Ive used for a couplr weeks and its half empty because the dropper sucks and how much you use is a LOT to cover your face

So, I am not a big fan of this. Everything I love about the Dokdo toner...this is the opposite. It's a nice watery consistency and it applies well...BUT, it is sticky and tacky, and after a few minutes, my entire face is already oily. Unlike the Dokdo toner, which is sticky for a few seconds and dries clean with no tackiness, the stickiness of the ampoule never goes away. For me, it felt a lot like how the Dokdo Lotion felt on my skin, where is just sat on top with that sticky/tacky feel. And I've read reviews that says it dries quickly with no stickiness. So, it is possible that this just doesn't work for my skin type. I also think my skin reacted with one or some of the ingredients since I put it on one night and woke up with little tiny pimples on my face. So, it could also be that it just didn't work for me personally.

extraits.titre: A must have for sensitive dry skin
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this product, I have very dry, sensitive skin that is also acne prone. This hydrates my skin without irritation or breakouts. I use this on damp skin before I moisturize and I also mix a drop into my moisturizer. Layers very nicely under makeup.

This ampoule is very moisturizing and lightweight. I like that you can layer this ampoule without it getting too heavy and would recommend this product for those who have dry and/or sensitive skin. The product is gentle enough to use daily as I apply it both during the day and night time and it helps to relieve any irritation/redness in my skin after using it, especially when I pair it with the other round lab products in the line. For those who have oily skin, this could serve well as a daily moisturizer with a couple of layers especially if you live in a hotter climate. The texture feels very light and the product is viscous but not too much so it is very easily spreadable. For days I feel extra dry, I mix the ampoule and the moisturizing cream from the same line(you can use any soothing cream you have on hand) for an extra boost of moisture(learned this hack from EuniUnni on Youtube). There is no scent to this product and it helps soothe the skin as well since this ampoule has a nice cooling effect and absorbs fairly quickly into the skin. Would love to buy this again. The only downside to this is the packaging because the dropper has a hard time sucking up product.

After trying out the 1025 Dokdo cleanser, toner, ampoule, and cream from a trial kit I ordered from another website, I was sold after just a couple of days and decided to order full sizes from the Round Lab website, getting the lotion in place of the cream. My skin has never been smoother, calmer, and softer than after using these products. Fine lines have greatly softened to where they are barely noticeable. I had a very mild case of dermatitis around my mouth and these products got rid of it quickly. I cannot recommend this line enough!

extraits.titre: This is my second purchase of this ampoule
extraits.texte: This is my second purchase of this ampoule. I Bo the first bottle in Seoul when I ran out of my serum while traveling. I use a prescription retinol cream at night and my skin often gets flaky. After I started using this ampoule daily, my skin stopped flaking and it's so smooth and clear. Nobody believes I am my age!
